agent_id.description: The agent to message. Alone, starts a new conversation with that agent; with conversation_id: default, targets its default conversation. For an external worker launched by Agent, pass the Agent ID from the Agent tool's result to resume that session.

conversation_id.description: The existing message thread to send to. Each conversation has its own message history. A conv-... or local-conv-... ID is sufficient; to use an agent's default thread, also supply agent_id. A subagent that omits both conversation_id and agent_id messages its parent.

computer.description: Optional computer where the recipient should run: cloud, an online computer name, or its stable device ID. Omitted, null, and blank values use its active computer or saved destination (a computer or Cloud sandbox). An offline saved computer does not trigger a Cloud-sandbox fallback.
